title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

reports.title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

summary:
New Jersey regulators fined DataOne $1.07 million for running 62 natural gas generators without required permits at its Vineland data center site. Inspectors found the units, each the size of a tractor trailer and rated at 2,000 kilowatts, during a July visit. State officials said this is the largest penalty ever imposed on a data center operator in New Jersey under the Air Pollution Control Act. The campus is planned as a 2.6 million square foot complex needing 350 megawatts of power, enough for a medium size city, and part of it is already operating.

The project has drawn complaints from neighbors, and a group of homeowners has filed a federal lawsuit over persistent noise. The Cumberland County Health Department has also issued violation orders for excessive noise. Governor Mikie Sherrill said developers must benefit New Jersey communities. The article does not state DataOne's next steps or whether it will appeal the fine.
